answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Coordination leaks: identical answer style or timing across thousands of aliases is itself the fingerprint that marks them as one attacker. Tending a trellis, watching a forge, and naming a karst is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
